# light_wikipedia_cli docs

Lightweight documentation site for the light_wikipedia_cli CLI and MCP server.

## Pages

- [Home](index.html) — overview and sections
- [Getting started](getting-started.html) — install and first run
- [CLI usage](cli.html) — flags and examples
- [MCP server](mcp.html) — configuration and tools
- [Project](project.html) — architecture and repository layout

## Key facts

- Two binaries: `wikipedia` (CLI) and `wikipedia-mcp` (MCP server)
- `wikipedia --tui` starts the interactive terminal UI
- `wikipedia --mcp` starts the MCP server from the CLI binary
- Flags: `--search`/`-s`, `--full`/`-f`, `--lang`/`-l`, `--random`/`-r`, `--tui`/`-t`, `--mcp`, `--no-color`, `--help`/`-h`

## Skill

The [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) file contains a machine-readable skill for AI agents to scaffold and build this documentation site.

## Key commands

```sh
make build        # build both binaries to bin/
make test         # run all tests
make docs         # generate this site from doc/content/
make serve        # serve at http://localhost:8000
```
